ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISCHANGED(Agency_Status__c),
OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Agency_Status__c),"In Active"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Agency_Status__c),"Suspended"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Agency_Status__c),"Rejected"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Agency_Status__c),"Blocked") ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Agency_Status__c,"Active"), ISPICKVAL(Agency_Status__c,"Pending Verification") )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Agency Status cannot be changed to Active or Pending Verification when the current status is In Active, Suspended, Rejected, or Blocked.
